page.title: Interview Prep
page.description: Practice interviews and test your skills with AI-powered assessments.

mockInterview.title: AI Mock Interview

panelInterview.description: Face a role-matched panel of three AI interviewers in one live room.

skillAssessment.title: Skill Assessment
skillAssessment.description: Topic-based MCQ quiz with scoring and weak-area detection.

skillSetup.title: Skill Assessment
skillSetup.description: Choose a topic and difficulty. Questions are generated by AI and scored on the server.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: Type a skill or topic — pick an AI suggestion, or keep what you typed.
topic.placeholder: e.g. React Hooks, MongoDB, System Design

difficulty.title: Difficulty
difficulty.description: Match the quiz to your experience level.

skillSetup.topicsLoadMessage: We could not load skill topics. Check your connection and try again.

session.loadFailed: Could not load this interview session. Start a new one from setup.
session.abandonedTitle: This interview session was not completed
session.abandonedDescription: The call was interrupted or timed out before submit. Start a new mock interview whenever you're ready — we don't score partial sessions.
session.completeDescription: Your combined content, voice, and video feedback is ready.
session.submitMissingReport: Interview submitted but report was missing.
session.incompleteDescription: No evaluation was saved for this session. Start a new mock interview whenever you're ready.
session.reportUnavailableDescription: This interview has no saved evaluation. We don't generate a new score from missing data.

history.title: Interview History

live.title: Live interview
live.subtitleVoice: Real-time practice. Mic stays on for feedback.
live.subtitleVideo: Real-time practice. Camera and mic stay on for feedback.
live.subtitlePanelVoice: Panel practice. Mic stays on for feedback.
live.subtitlePanelVideo: Panel practice. Camera and mic stay on for feedback.
live.idleSubtitleVoice: Check your mic, then start when you’re ready.
live.idleSubtitleVideo: Check camera and mic, then start when you’re ready.
live.trustLine: Used only for your interview feedback — not shared publicly.

tips.title: Tips for a better interview
tips.compact: Speak clearly · Face the camera · Keep mic unmuted
tips.compactVoice: Speak clearly · Keep mic unmuted · Quiet room
tips.mic: Use a working microphone — close Zoom/Teams if the mic is busy.
tips.camera: Keep your camera on and look straight at it.
tips.quiet: Sit in a quiet place with stable internet.
tips.speak: Speak clearly and pause briefly after each answer.

live.connectingDescription: Joining your interviewer — this usually takes a few seconds.
live.transcriptEmpty: Transcript will appear as you speak…
live.transcriptEmptyHint: Your conversation will appear here once the interview starts.
live.endConfirmDescription: We'll stop the call and generate your feedback report.
live.missingAssistant: Interview assistant is not ready. Please go back and start again.
live.faceModelsFailed: Face analysis models could not load. Eye-contact metrics may be unavailable.
live.endedNoConversation: The interview ended before any conversation was recorded. Please start it again.
live.endedNoConversationWithReason: The interview ended before any conversation was recorded ({{reason}}). Please start it again.
live.micJoinFailed: The voice room closed because the microphone never joined. Close Zoom/Teams or other apps using the mic, then start the interview again.

report.description: AI summary based on your answers, voice delivery, and on-camera presence.

report.retryGenerateDescription: Report generation didn't finish. Your interview data is saved — try again.

reviewMistakes.description: See what you missed and the correct answers.

permissions.denied: Camera or microphone access was blocked. Allow both in your browser site settings, then try again.
permissions.not_found: No camera or microphone was found on this device. Connect a mic/webcam or use a device that has them, then try again.
permissions.in_use: Your camera or microphone may already be in use by another app (Zoom, Teams, etc.). Close that app and try again.
permissions.unknown: We could not access your camera or microphone. Check your device and browser permissions, then try again.

vapi.voiceCallErrorDetail: Voice call error. Check your Vapi public key and microphone access.
